## Installing the Python SDK

Aptos provides an official Python SDK on
[PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/aptos-sdk/) with source code in the
[aptos-python-sdk GitHub repository](https://github.com/aptos-labs/aptos-python-sdk).
The SDK requires **Python 3.12+**.

Install with `pip`:

```shellscript filename="Terminal"
pip install aptos-sdk
```

Or from source:

```shellscript filename="Terminal"
git clone https://github.com/aptos-labs/aptos-python-sdk
cd aptos-python-sdk
pip install .
```

<Aside type="note">
  New code should use the v2 API (`aptos_sdk.v2`). The v1 API (`RestClient`,
  `Account.generate()` from `aptos_sdk.account`) remains in the same package
  for existing tutorials. See the
  [v1 to v2 migration guide](https://github.com/aptos-labs/aptos-python-sdk/blob/main/MIGRATION.md)
  in the SDK repository.
</Aside>
